User-confirmed GPT and GPT-5.5 effective context window: 258k tokens. Superseded as frontier by gpt-5.6-sol (Codex model cache 2026-07-09 declares sol 'Latest frontier agentic coding model', priority 1); gpt-5.5 was the prior default ('Frontier', priority 0).
User-confirmed Codex Spark context window: 122k tokens.
DeepSeek pricing (api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing): V4 Pro/Flash 1M context, 384K max output. Legacy deepseek-chat/deepseek-reasoner are v4-flash modes (deprecated 2026/07/24).

Anthropic public positioning: Fable-5 is the Mythos-class tier, positioned above Opus. context_window is LIVE: context_window_for_canonical consults the declared sources (custom-provider declaration, then this catalog) before the name-shape guesses, so this row is authoritative. Its value equals what the legacy claude-family guess returned, so the reorder moved no built-in window. | Request BODY byte ceiling (NOT the token context window): Anthropic Messages API documents a 32MB maximum request size; a 413 request_too_large is returned above it. PROVENANCE: assistant knowledge, NOT user-confirmed — correct this figure if the documented limit differs. Consumed by request_too_large_preflight in providers/anthropic.rs to reject an oversized body before upload; an absent value simply disables the preflight.

Google Antigravity backend registry, read 2026-08-20 via cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com/v1internal:fetchAvailableModels. That registry is the serving list: it publishes gemini-3.6-flash-low/-medium/-high, gemini-3.5-flash-extra-low/-low, gemini-3.1-pro-low, gemini-3-flash-agent and gemini-pro-agent, and carries NO bare gemini-3.6-flash / gemini-3.5-flash / gemini-3.x-pro id at all — the reasoning tier is part of the model id. Display names in that response map gemini-3-flash-agent to "Gemini 3.5 Flash (High)", and deprecatedModelIds redirects gemini-3.1-pro-high to gemini-pro-agent, which is why those two ids carry the high rung. No context window is declared here: the registry does not publish one, and inventing a figure is exactly what this catalog forbids.
